items.title: Anime and film upscale
items.text: The TV's own picture processors tuned from D to A while you watch. No root needed.

items.title: Clean sources
items.text: Fakes, other episodes and other titles left out, checked against the title, season and episode.

items.title: Faster start
items.text: The best stream is picked sooner, and films start without waiting for their previews.

items.title: I use debrid
items.text: Remuxes and high bitrates picked freely for debrid users.

items.title: Cleaner subtitles
items.text: A soft drop shadow you can set, and ( ) and quotation marks taken out.

items.title: Sound for this TV
items.text: Clear dialogue on the TV's speakers, the full mix for a soundbar, DTS as stereo or 5.1.

items.title: Beta updates
items.text: Try new versions early from Settings > About. Off by default.
